principle: Promotion requires measurable out-of-development improvement, zero leakage, and no material deterioration in seat or probabilistic performance. Narrative plausibility receives zero credit.
hard_validity_gates: Preregistration validator PASS before any judgment.
Exactly 92 valid judgment objects per executed condition and election.
No post-hoc exclusions or threshold changes.

development_sanity_gate.purpose: Reject a reasoner that cannot even fit the development election under the frozen calibration grid.

consequence.E_REASON_PROMOTE: Authorize a separately certified 2026 application using the fully frozen packet schema, C2 prompt, ordinal mapping and lambda. This authorizes an F1 candidate, not rewriting F0.
consequence.otherwise: F0 remains the official forecast; no F1 is created.

human_arm_rule: H1 is not required for initial C2 promotion. No claim about human superiority, parity or inferiority is allowed unless H1 is genuinely executed and scored.
